title: Versioned reference protocol and BCL runner
api_or_output: Versioned reference protocol and BCL runner

acceptance.description: Define the versioned JSONL request/response and operation payload contract, implement the BCL XML runner and managed reference process client, and run one known XML fixture with actual runtime/build metadata.

Test request/response identity and semantic normalization, invalid protocol/requests, process failure categorization, timeout/cancellation, offline resource mapping and denied unconfigured external access; keep infrastructure failures distinct from parse rejection.
Demonstrate the task using only verified M0-build; run focused tests and preserved bootstrap checks at a known implementation revision, record protocol/runner outputs and task validation.
